variants.subject: a proposal for algoalpha (no cost, no commitment)
variants.body:
Hi team,

Here is the offer.

I will build algoalpha a full email marketing campaign for free. Every dollar it generates is yours. I want nothing upfront and nothing after.

What I deliver:

1. Seven high converting emails written specifically for your subscriber base. Angles tested in similar verticals: re-engaging churned trial users, upselling Indicators subscribers to the 68.97 dollar VIP Bundle, and pushing annual plans for the 57 percent savings stack.

2. Full sending infrastructure. Verified domain, warmed up, deliverability tuned. Inbox placement north of 95 percent on the first send, not landing in promotions.

3. Live tracking dashboard. Every open, click, reply, and sale visible the moment we ship. You see the same numbers I see.

What I want in return: one 60 second video testimonial, only if the results are real. If the campaign produces zero revenue, you owe me nothing and we both walk. No retainer, no setup fee, no contract.

Why I am doing this for free: I am building a case study portfolio in fintech and trading SaaS this quarter, and algoalpha fits the profile I want to feature. Two pilot slots open. After this quarter intake closes until Q3.

All upside on your end. My time is the only risk on the table.

If this is aligned, reply with YES and I will send the full scope this week.
